ideas.pitch: An AI-powered dynamic workspace and team collaboration suite featuring real-time availability tracking and intelligent desk/room allocation tailored for modern hybrid co-working spaces.
ideas.title: AuraDesk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on high-polish web implementation and real-time state tracking, matching the design-to-code philosophy of Code and Craft.

ideas.pitch: An authentic language learning application driven by user-generated short-form video clips, matching local speakers with learners for contextual micro-lessons.
ideas.title: LingoShorts
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a visually compelling Figma design system with a functional social media feed layout, hitting the 'Ideate and Create' and 'Bring to Life' judging phases perfectly.

ideas.pitch: A localized asset and finance management web application designed for rural administrative bodies to track public utility infrastructure and consumable resources.
ideas.title: JalGram
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a deeply practical civic problem with clear UI dashboards, making it an exceptional candidate for judges looking for real-world impact combined with solid design execution.

ideas.pitch: An interactive, low-latency RAG-based voice assistant that helps users query complex documentation and receive accurate spoken answers in real-time.
ideas.title: VoiceRAG Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a working live demo of voice-to-text integration that directly captures judge attention during the live Q&A showcase.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight decentralized voting dashboard allowing transparent ballot casting and verifiable cryptographic tallying for institutional elections.
ideas.title: SecureTrust Vote
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced cryptographic visual representations in the design phase to immediately impress judges in the design conceptualization round.
